model: AROB series universal room controller (Modbus communication module)
equipment_type: Thermostat / room controller (temperature, humidity, CO2, VOC)
applies_to: Neptronic AROB24T / AROB24TH / AROB24TGH / AROB24TGVH universal room controllers with the Modbus module, ARO Modbus Guide_170824.
summary: The AROB is a wall-mounted universal room controller with temperature and optional humidity, CO2 and VOC sensors, two analog and two binary outputs. Its Modbus RTU module exposes the sensor readings, calibrations, output values and their configuration, cooling, heating, humidity, CO2 and VOC setpoints with limits, PI bands and demands, the system and fan modes, and occupancy / filter / airflow input states, all as holding registers.

addressing.note: Registers are printed from 40000. The intro puts the device address at holding register index 0, auto baud at index 1 and the port settings at index 2, which are the rows printed 40000-40002, so the wire address is the printed number minus 40000 (42075 cooling setpoint = address 2075). Same layout as Neptronic's TUXB guide.

source.title: AROB Series Universal Room Controller - Modbus Communication Module User Guide

notes: Only function codes 03, 06 and 16 are supported; everything is a holding register.
'Scale N' with 'Value x N' means raw = engineering value x N; the multiplier here is 1/N.
Temperatures and enthalpy follow the network units register (40034): 0 metric, 1 imperial.
Left out: product name ASCII registers 40003-40006; alarm status 40009/40010 (all bits reserved); enthalpy 40016 (its example value lies outside its printed range).
40029 and 40030 are both printed 'Binary Output 1 value'; both are listed as printed.
Several output and lockout registers apply only when an App Profile (42123) is selected, or need the matching sensor; this is noted per register.
The display and lock option bit tables (40031, 40035) are printed in two interleaved columns; only the bit names are given here (1 = yes / on).

integration.summary: Read temperature (13), CO2 (11) and VOC (12) and the cooling / heating demands (2074, 2083). Set Main system mode (2116) and Temperature system mode (2117), then write the cooling and heating setpoints (2075, 2084; x10).
integration.enable: Fit the Modbus communication module and set the address from the device menu or register 0.
quirks: Printed register numbers start at 40000 for address 0.
Auto baud detection is the default; supported rates 9600-76800 per the text (the register row lists up to 57600).
gotchas: OAT lockouts work only when analog input 1 mode (42000) is set to OAT sensor.
Unoccupied setpoints need an input (42000/42001) set to occupancy.
